title: Secure implementation
base/fieldTypes/comment: No open vulnerabilities in the pinned version at the time of assessment. The historical CVEs are overwhelmingly reachable only when untrusted SQL or untrusted database files are processed. Neither applies here: the device executes only our own statements, and the database file is created and written by the device itself. The residual concern is a malformed database file after flash corruption, which is handled by validating and rebuilding the store on open failure.
